recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If Terminology Infrastructure wants the THO 'Using UCUM with HL7 Standards' page to mirror the Quantity best-practice guidance, that follow-up belongs in THO/UTG rather than this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-33063 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request, raised in R4 and applied for R5, asking the core UCUM page to discourage curly-brace content in UCUM code expressions because braces add descriptive text but do not contribute to code meaning.
initial_application: Commit 19d78411d5a1784e71184f70e91244a6b520a575 applied the issue on 2022-02-01 by adding the requested two-sentence curly-brace warning to source/ucum.html. That page no longer exists in current core source.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 later moved the external code-system usage pages from FHIR core to HL7 Terminology and deleted source/ucum.html, updating source/terminologies-systems.html to link to THO. FHIR-42788 later added a best-practice invariant on Quantity that warns UCUM annotations such as {Z-Score} can be misleading and recommends using Quantity.unit for human-readable unit text. The origin Zulip thread and FHIR-27540 no-change decision support this as guidance rather than a prohibition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing a core UCUM page or duplicating the Quantity guidance on the code-system index would conflict with the later page migration and create maintenance drift; the current core source already conveys the implementer-facing guidance in build-scope Quantity datatype source.
